question: What has Raymond James said about its affiliation models, and has the mix shifted?

claims.text: Raymond James offers multiple affiliation options, which it refers to as AdvisorChoice®, spanning employee, independent contractor, and RIA & Custody Services (RCS) affiliation models.
Raymond James says it is agnostic about how advisors affiliate and offers all the affiliation options, giving it the largest addressable market in the industry.
Raymond James names private equity-backed roll-ups as competitors, saying they have been extremely aggressive in paying higher and higher multiples for advisors over the last three years.

The mix has shifted over time, per Raymond James: its RCS division has by far the highest percentage growth, the independent contractor channel led a couple of years ago, and the employee channel led the way in fiscal 2024.
Raymond James' CEO said over the last year much more recruiting has come from the independent side versus the employee side, indicating a mix shift toward independent.

adjacent.text: Raymond James reported 3,878 employee financial advisors as of September 30, 2025.
adjacent.differs_because: Advisor headcount by affiliation model is the closest disclosed figure for the mix, not the mix of assets or revenue itself; advisors in RCS are not included in this count.

adjacent.text: Raymond James reported 5,065 independent contractor financial advisors as of September 30, 2025.
